title: Descent of bounded graded finite projective module terms
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $X^n$ for $n\in\mathbb Z$ be finite projective $A$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], and let $a,b\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy $X^n=0$ whenever $n<a$ or $b<n$. There are $i\in I$ and finite projective $F(i)$-modules $M^n$, zero whenever $n<a$ or $b<n$, with isomorphisms $M^n\otimes_{F(i)}A\cong X^n$ in every degree, using the canonical map $F(i)\to A$. No maps between the terms are asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-finite-projective-module-colimit-descent] to each term Xⁿ, obtaining a stage i(n), a finite projective model N(n), and a base-change isomorphism. Only the finite integer interval s=[a,b] is used in the assembly.

Take a common upper bound j of the finite image of s under i, by induction on the finite set and directedness; use any index in the empty case. For n in s let M(n) be the scalar extension of N(n) from i(n) to j. Module.Finite.base_change and Module.Projective.tensorProduct give finiteness and projectivity. The colimit cocone identity and ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp give a canonical isomorphism between the iterated base change of N(n) and its direct colimit base change; compose with the chosen model isomorphism.

For n outside s put M(n)=PUnit with its zero module structure. This module is finite and projective and is zero. Extension of scalars preserves zero objects, so its colimit base change is canonically isomorphic to the given zero term Xⁿ. The elementary integer inequalities identify the complement of s with n<a or b<n. These constructions prove every support, finiteness, projectivity and degreewise-isomorphism clause, also when b<a.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_projective_graded_model_of_directed_colimit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F] (X : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u})) (a b : ℤ) (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (X n)) (hfinite : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}) (X n)) (hprojective : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}) (X n)) : ∃ (i : I) (M : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i)), (∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (M n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (F.obj i) (M n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (F.obj i) (M n)) ∧ Nonempty (∀ n : ℤ, (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj (M n) ≅ X n)
